content.name: Karthik Raghavan
content.title: DevOps Engineer
content.summary: DevOps engineer with nine years in Chennai, starting in server support and moving through build and release work for an insurer. Today runs AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure for an e-commerce platform that handled 14 lakh orders on its biggest festive-sale day. Hands-on with Jenkins, Terraform and incident response.

experience.title: Systems Engineer
bullets: Supported 250 Linux and Windows servers for offshore client projects under strict SLA response times.
Wrote shell scripts for log rotation and disk alerts that cut disk-full incidents by more than half.
Cleared the Red Hat Certified System Administrator exam in my first year while working night shifts.

experience.title: Build and Release Engineer
bullets: Maintained Jenkins pipelines for 40 Java applications and introduced shared libraries to remove duplicated job code.
Shifted policy-servicing releases from monthly to weekly by adding automated smoke tests and rollback steps.
Containerised the claims portal with Docker, reducing environment-related defects reported by QA by around 35%.
Coordinated release calls with QA, business and vendor teams for every production change.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
bullets: Run Amazon EKS clusters and Terraform-managed infrastructure for a marketplace that peaked at 14 lakh orders in one festive-sale day.
Ran load tests and pre-scaling for the sale, keeping checkout error rates below 0.3% at peak traffic.
Lowered monthly AWS cost by ₹9 lakh by rightsizing instances and moving batch jobs to Spot capacity.
Lead incident calls on my on-call weeks and mentor two associate engineers on Kubernetes and Terraform.

achievements.title: Spot award for festive-sale readiness
achievements.detail: Recognised by the CTO for zero downtime during the 2024 sale season.

achievements.title: Speaker, Chennai DevOps meetup
achievements.detail: Talk on running Jenkins shared libraries at scale.
